name: Kibira National Park
story: Kibira National Park covers 400 km2 of northwestern Burundi atop the mountains of the Congo-Nile Divide. It features primary montane rainforest, which is the only montane forest in all of Burundi, and is home to chimpanzees and black-and-white colobus monkeys.
matters: It is considered the most important site in Burundi for the conservation of montane-forest birds. Additionally, the water from its forests accounts for over three-quarters of the water that goes into the country's largest dam.
